  read_only:
  - /opt/dd-config
  - /home/sandbox
  - /usr
  - /lib
  - /proc
  - /dev/urandom
  read_write:
  - /sandbox
network_policies:
  lab_router:
    endpoints:
    - host: 172.16.0.5
      port: 4000
      protocol: rest
      enforcement: enforce
      allowed_ips:
      - 172.16.0.5/32
      rules:
      - allow:
          method: '*'
          path: /v1/**
    binaries:
    - path: /usr/local/bin/python3.13
